# Adrian Treleaven

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c24 P12](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0012), [v4 c5 P8](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0008)</sub>
- **Role:** Journalist and author  <sub>[v1 c24 P12](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0012), [v4 c24 P15](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Adrian is a tall, broad-shouldered, handsome man with thick brown hair, a sharp nose and chin, and large, dark-gray eyes. His face is expressive, displaying wit and charm when he smiles, though it can appear sorrowful when still.

_Sources: [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 c24 P8](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0008)_

## Personality

Adrian is an imaginative, articulate, and passionate man with an engaging, charming manner and a keen sense of humor. He possesses deep sensitivity, warmth, and an intense romantic nature, though he suffers quietly when faced with emotional pain and is deeply honorable regarding his obligations.

_Sources: [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 c24 P15](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0015), [v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c26 P9](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0009)_

## Traits

- Imaginative and creative  <sub>[v4 c23 P18](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0018), [v4 c24 P15](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0015)</sub>
- Honorable and considerate  <sub>[v4 c26 P9](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0009)</sub>
- Passionate  <sub>[v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002)</sub>

## Abilities

- Writing and storytelling  <sub>[v4 c24 P15](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0015), [v4 c25 P11](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0011)</sub>

## Goals

- To write a great Canadian novel  <sub>[v4 c23 P19](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0019)</sub>

## History

Adrian Treleaven traveled to Seven Gulls Harbor to recover from typhoid fever and to visit the ancestral home of his grandparents, John and Damaris Tremayne. While staying at Echo Cottage as a boarder with Lorna Vane, he discovered the handwritten life-book of Captain Saul Garrick and received permission to adapt the captain's maritime adventures into a novel. Over the course of the summer, Adrian worked on his book at the lighthouse and developed a deep, silent love for Lorna Vane, though he kept his feelings secret out of respect for her marriage. Before departing, he confided his love for Lorna to Nell Harcourt, believing he would never see Lorna again. Later, after it was discovered that Lorna's missing husband had died years prior and that she was legally free, Adrian returned to Seven Gulls, declared his love for her, and they became engaged. The two were married the following June in the garden of Echo Cottage.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P12](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0012), [v4 c24 P15](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0015), [v4 c25 P2](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0002), [v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c26 P9](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0009), [v4 c36 P33](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0033), [v4 c38 P8](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0008), [v4 c38 P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010), [v4 c40 P33](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0033)_

## Background by volume

- He is the son of Alice Tremayne and the grandson of John Tremayne, the former Brierley schoolmaster  <sub>[v1 c24 P12](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0012), [v4 c24 P21](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0021)</sub>
- He previously suffered a severe attack of typhoid fever  <sub>[v1 c24 P12](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0012)</sub>

## Quotes

> I have a strange sensation of returning home.  <sub>[v4 c23 P11](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0011)</sub>

> Loving her and parting from her causes a scorching, searing agony—yet never having loved her remains completely unimaginable.  <sub>[v4 c26 P20](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0020)</sub>

> Lorna, you are aware—you comprehend. I have adored you since the beginning.  <sub>[v4 c38 P9](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0009)</sub>


## Relationships

### Lorna Vane

- Spouse of — Adrian fell deeply in love with Lorna while boarding at her cottage and eventually married her.  <sub>[v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c38 P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010), [v4 c40 P33](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0033)</sub>

### Captain Saul Garrick

- Friend of — Captain Saul shared his life-book and sea tales with Adrian to adapt into a published book.  <sub>[v4 c24 P15](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0015), [v4 c25 P2](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0002)</sub>
